lastCompletedStory.title: Graceful degradation when review-report.json is missing or malformed

nextStoryContext: US-004 added warnFn?: (msg: string) => void to MakeReviewDispatchOptions in review.ts. Default is console.warn. Warning is emitted exactly once (at verdict-resolution time, not per poll) when readReviewReport was injected but returned null and the tag-based fallback is used. Five new tests added under 'makeReviewDispatch: graceful degradation (US-004)': missing-file, malformed-JSON, loop-not-wedged (3 fix stories), no-warning-when-reader-absent, and warning-exactly-once. 1278 tests total pass. US-005 is next: document the review-report.json flow in the recovery runbook and patterns.
